doc: The 'continuation' group of host calls (cleat#3827). Each call is listed here as unbound ('pending: ...') until its binding lands; the PR that binds a call moves its entry from 'unbound' to 'bound' in THIS file and touches no other inventory file. See packages/cleat-ts/groups/README.md.

unbound.cleat_continue_as_new: pending: end this run and start a fresh one with a new input.
unbound.cleat_continue_as_new_versioned: pending: the same, carrying a workflow version forward.
